preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 1000 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Each test case has n between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == 2 * n for a, n in zip(as_, ns))
preconditions.description: Each array a has exactly 2n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**6 for a in as_ for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in array a is between 1 and 10^6.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i][0] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each test case output starts with 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i][1] == '' if output[i][0] == 'NO' else isinstance(output[i][1], int) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'NO', there is no second line. If 'YES', the second line is an integer x.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output[i][2:]) == ns[i] if output[i][0] == 'YES' else len(output[i][2:]) == 0 for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', there are exactly n lines describing the operations. If 'NO', there are no additional lines.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output[i][2+j], tuple) and len(output[i][2+j]) == 2 for i in range(t) for j in range(ns[i]))
postconditions.description: Each operation is described by a pair of integers.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(output[i][2+j]) == output[i][1] for i in range(t) for j in range(ns[i]))
postconditions.description: Each pair of integers in the operations sums to the chosen x.

postconditions.expression: all(max(output[i][2+j]) == output[i][1] for i in range(t) for j in range(ns[i]))
postconditions.description: After each operation, x is updated to the maximum of the removed pair.
